exposure: Beliefs and experiences about managing postpartum pain
Use of medications for postpartum pain
Use of behavioral strategies for postpartum pain
outcome: Reported combination of medications and behavioral strategies for pain management
Reported disadvantages of medications and physical activity
Preference for more evidence-based education on behavioral strategies
cohort: 32 postpartum women participated in semi-structured interviews.
finding: Most women used a combination of prescription medications and non-prescription behavioral strategies for postpartum pain, reported disadvantages associated with both, and desired more evidence-based education on behavioral strategies during prenatal visits.
